rows.en:
Unable to bear the pain, she screamed.
And in front of her family, who came running in alarm, something unbelievable happened.
Her body began to ripple and undulate.
As if everything under her skin had turned to liquid.
...No, it really had turned to liquid.
The tentacles burst out through her skin with such force, and a cloudy white fluid came flowing from their tips.
When that fluid dripped onto the floor, it sizzled and smoke rose up.{p}

Yes, that fluid could dissolve things, like a strong acid.
Strangely enough, it didn't dissolve her skin.
So only the flesh under her skin melted away, and her body became like a water balloon.
...Yes, of course, by then she had already breathed her last.{p}

But who on earth was the caller who had hounded her that far?
Date?
Or someone else?
...Now, no one will ever know.
But whoever it was... one thing is certain: it wasn't human, don't you think?
And that's the end of my story.{p}
She didn't pick up the receiver.

Then the ringing stopped.
Ironically, once that happened, she couldn't stop thinking about the phone.
So she quietly reached out.
Just as she was about to pick up the receiver, someone tapped her on the shoulder from behind.{p}

She jumped and spun around, and there stood Date.
"So this is where you were."
That's what he was saying.
Yaguchi acted a little angry.
"What do you mean, 'so this is where you were'?
You called me from here, didn't you, Date?
That's why I..."
"I didn't call you or anybody."
Date shook his head.
"What? But..."
"You said you'd call me, so I was waiting.
But then I got this bad feeling... so I came looking for you."
Yaguchi couldn't say a word.{p}

Partly she was startled, and partly she was happy that Date had worried about her that much.
But then, who was it that had called her?{p}

Just then, as if in answer to that question, the phone began to ring.
And mixed in with the ringing, she heard a low, hoarse man's voice.

"Damn you for getting in my way... A little more and she would have been mine."
The voice came from the phone.
Even though no one had picked up the receiver yet.
"What the hell is this?"
Date said, reaching out his hand.{p}
And then the receiver came off the hook all by itself!

The receiver attacked Date and strangled him with its cord.
"Stop it!"
Yaguchi threw herself at it.
But the receiver struck her hard on the temple, and she passed out.{p}

......And the next day, the two of them were found.
Date, strangled with the phone cord, and Yaguchi lying collapsed beside him.
The small-minded adults decided it was a breakup that had turned ugly.
They wouldn't even listen to what Yaguchi had to say.
Honestly, how thickheaded adults are.
It's adults like that who deserve to be killed by ghosts.
Don't you think so?{p}

...Anyway, that was the end of the incident.
If Date had never called her from that pay phone, none of this would have happened, I think.
The devil that lives in that phone must have taken a liking to Yaguchi's voice.
So it tried to drag her into its own world, but Date got in its way, and so...
Well, it's too late to think about all that now, isn't it?{p}

She still left it alone, and then, of all things, the receiver began to rattle and shake.
Stifling a scream, she tried to run away.{p}
But something caught her feet, and she fell.{p}

When she looked, countless receivers reaching out of the darkness had wrapped themselves around her legs.
And the receiver that had come off the pay phone was coming toward her.
A low voice kept leaking out of it.
"At last we've caught you... our queen.
That beautiful voice of yours..."{p}

As Yaguchi tried to scream, the receiver swallowed her with a slurp.
Yes, there's no other word for it but 'swallowed.'
Half of Yaguchi's body was sticking out of a receiver no bigger than a fist.
It was like some absurd joke of surrealism.
And then the receiver slowly gulped down the rest of her.{p}

All that was left behind was a single shoe.
After that, no one ever found out what became of her.{p}

There was a huge uproar, but there's no way they'll ever find her.
She's inside the phone, after all.
How do I know all this, you ask?
Yaguchi told me herself.
When you're on the phone, sometimes you hear a crackle of static, don't you?
That's Yaguchi's signal.
If you're lucky, you should hear her voice right after it.
I've talked with her many times already.
You should listen carefully too, {a}.
Well then, I'll end it here.{p}

Too afraid even to make a sound, she stayed silent.
Then she heard a voice on the other end of the line.
"..................ere..."
"What?"
It was far away, but she definitely heard it.{p}

She pressed the receiver against her ear.
"What is it?
What did you say?"
Then, right at her ear, she heard a voice so close she could almost hear it breathing.
"I'm right here..."
Yaguchi froze.
"I'm right here..."
The voice kept repeating it, and then it went on to say something horrible.{p}

"Right behind you..."
Yaguchi tried to turn around.
But she couldn't.
It was as though the muscles in her neck had locked up.
And then, at long last, a breath really did blow on her from behind.

"I'm right here..."
A voice so close she could almost feel its body heat.
It even felt as if it were speaking just a few centimeters from her ear.
But the voice was coming from the receiver.
She wanted to see who it was.
But she couldn't turn around.{p}

Just then, she noticed the mirror hanging above the phone.
With this, she could see who it was without turning around.
She used the mirror to look behind her.
And there............{p}

There was no one.
No one at all.
But she could still hear the breathing right at her ear.
And that thing said,
"Give me your voice..."

Yaguchi screamed.
And then she fainted.{p}

When she was found the next day, Yaguchi had lost her voice.
The doctor apparently said it was probably the mental shock of going through something so terrifying.
But it's nothing of the sort.
She believes that thing stole her voice.{p}

Remember how Date once called Yaguchi from there?
That must be when it took a liking to her.
So they say if you call the weather forecast or directory assistance from that phone, you won't hear the machine. You'll hear Yaguchi's voice.
I haven't tried it myself yet, though.
And that's the end of my story.{p}

With that, Iwashita looked at me.
"Would you like me to tell you what happened?"
"Uh... y-yes, of course I would."
When I nodded, Iwashita stood up.{p}

"Since you're the one asking, {a}, I'll do it.
But in return, you have to kiss me."
I couldn't believe my ears.
A kiss?
And right here, right now★
"I'm not joking.
I mean it."
Was Iwashita out of her mind?
She was staring straight at me.
The others seemed dumbfounded too.
"If you don't kiss me, I won't tell you."
Iwashita kept pressing, as if it were a threat.{p}

She left her seat and came right up to me.
"I like you, {a}.
Kiss me right now.
I'm helping out with the newspaper club's feature, so that much is fair, isn't it?"
She made it sound like I owed her.
I was a little annoyed.
But Iwashita didn't care in the least.
"Kiss me, I said!
Don't you care if the seven wonders never get finished★"{p}

She grabbed my arm.
I shook her off without thinking.
Iwashita lost her balance and fell.

Bright red blood was smeared thick on the corner of the desk.
"Iwashita!"
Her eyes were shut tight.
She couldn't be... dead★
I never meant for this to happen...
Just then, her eyes snapped wide open.
Blood trickled slowly from her blue lips.
A hoarse voice escaped her.{p}

"So you're killing me again... Doing that won't let you escape..."
A violent wave of dizziness hit me.{p}

A few seconds later, I realized I was sitting back in my original seat.
Iwashita was sitting properly in her seat too.
I went pale.
I felt as if I already knew what Iwashita was going to say next.
"Well then, I'll be telling the fifth story, I suppose."{p}

A few seconds later, I realized I was sitting back in my original seat.
Iwashita was sitting properly in her seat too.
What was that just now?
A daydream...?
I was still wondering that when Iwashita's words froze me.
"Well then, I'll be telling the fifth story, I suppose."{p}

"Please, stop it already☆"
I shouted.
I couldn't take this anymore.
Was I going to be trapped in this place for the rest of my life★{p}
Blood trickled slowly from the corner of her mouth.{p}

Pale lips and bright red blood.
Just like what I saw before...
As I thought this in a daze, Iwashita gave me a cold smile.
"But it's no use.
I told you I'd curse you, didn't I... From now on, you'll be with me forever and ever."
Everything around me lurched and warped.{p}

I fell into pitch darkness where I couldn't tell up from down.
Iwashita's voice echoed.
"We'll be together.
Forever..."
Forever...
Forever...

Forever...
Forever...
Forever...
And then I knew nothing more.{p}

"Aaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
Yaguchi flung the receiver away.
When she clapped a hand to her ear without thinking, it was burning hot.
And her palm came away smeared with something slimy and wet.
It was blood.
Her legs gave out, she slumped down on the spot, and she couldn't move anymore.{p}

"Aaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
Yaguchi flung the receiver away.
Hot, slimy liquid was gushing from her ear.
Yes, something had torn her ear clean off!
She looked at the receiver, flung aside and swinging back and forth, and the part she'd held to her ear was dyed bright red.
Her blood.
And the receiver was gnashing its teeth, clack, clack.
Do you understand?{p}

The earpiece had become a round mouth, packed with rows of sharp teeth.
She tried to run away.
But her legs had given out, and she couldn't stand up properly.
And the receiver attacked her once more.
Its cord wound around her like a snake.
And its sharp teeth began to gnaw at her, crunch, crunch!
To be eaten alive...
Can you imagine it, {a}?
It must hurt so much, and be so unbearably bitter, that you'd wish it were all just a dream... I suppose.
If it swallowed you in one gulp, that would be easier, but when it's a phone receiver, it can't do that, can it?{p}

...The next day, Yaguchi was found.
They say her corpse was a gruesome sight, as if a swarm of small animals had gnawed on it.
No one knows why that phone set its sights on her.
But maybe the ghost phone was in love with Yaguchi.
So it tried to make her its own, forever.{p}

...Heh heh, you might think that's a terrible thing to inflict on someone, but somehow I understand it.
I feel like I could do anything at all to make the one I love mine.
Heh heh heh heh...
My story is over.{p}

Having said that much, Iwashita grinned at me.
Blood trickled slowly from her lips.{p}

A few seconds later, I realized I was sitting back in my original seat.
Iwashita was sitting properly in her seat too.
I went pale.
I felt as if I already knew what Iwashita was going to say next.
"Well then, I'll be telling the fifth story, I suppose."{p}
Well, how about it, {a}?{p}Have you made up your mind to make me your sweetheart?
I have
I haven't
Shout, "Just stop it!"

I'm so happy.
I'll call you tonight, right away.{p}
Heh heh... Well then, next is the sixth story.{p}
Now, shall we hear the sixth person's story?{p}
And next, at last, is the sixth one.{p}
The sixth story, if you please.{p}
Shall we hear the sixth story?{p}
Come on, let's hear the next story.{p}
And who might the sixth be?{p}
Our sixth storyteller, go right ahead.{p}
